import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    A = p[0] + p[1]*t
    return p[2]*P*(P - A)*(p[3] - P) + p[4]*P*(1 - P/p[5]) * t + p[6]*P + p[7]*t + p[8]*t*P**2 + p[9]

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    K = p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*t**2
    r = p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*t) + p[5]
    return r*P*(1 - (P/K)**p[6]) + p[7]*P*t + p[8]*t**2 + p[9]*P**2*t
